name: Variable (Design token for Framer)
summary: Framer plugin that creates design tokens on the canvas, binds them to element properties and keeps them in collections with modes.
description: Plugin for Framer that manages design tokens without leaving the canvas. Variables come in 11 types with aliases and math, can be scoped, and live in collections with per-mode values such as light/dark or desktop/mobile. Tokens bind to layout, visual style and typography properties, and import/export covers W3C DTCG, Figma Tokens JSON and AI design-system prompts. By Iklil Najma Muqtafa, tagged Styles.
contains: 11 variable types: color, number, string, boolean, dropdown, typography, spacing, sizing, radius, border width, opacity
aliases and math such as {spacing/md} * 2; scopes restrict variables to properties
collections with per-mode values (light/dark, desktop/mobile) and breakpoint auto-switch
binds tokens to layout, style and typography properties, including master components
import: W3C DTCG, Figma Tokens, custom JSON; export: JSON, DTCG and AI design-system prompts
by Iklil Najma Muqtafa, published Sep 22, 2026; license: limited; tag: styles
